chosen.title: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press (Tutorial + Tips) | Team Evolve
chosen.description:
This video will teach you how to execute The Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press with proper technique and additional form tips that you may also find helpful:

Tutorial Cheat Sheet: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press

1) Keep your feet hip-width apart and core engaged as you press the dumbbells up overhead touching the dumbbells together at the top
2) As you lower the dumbbells down, keep your elbows positioned slightly in front of your torso
3) Tempo: Slowly lower the dumbbells down on a 3 second count

candidates.title: How to do a Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press!
The PERFECT Dumbbell Shoulder Press (DO THIS!)
candidates.description:
The Perfect Dumbbell Shoulder Press: Key Tips

1️⃣ Adjust the Bench Angle: Set the bench to an incline of roughly 70 degrees. Avoid a fully upright 90-degree angle to reduce unnecessary shoulder strain.

2️⃣ Position Yourself Correctly: Slide your butt all the way back, ensuring your entire back is firmly pressed against the bench for maximum stability.

3️⃣ Optimal Elbow Position: As you lower the dumbbells, keep your elbows slightly in front of your shoulders. This minimizes shoulder strain and ensures a safer, more effective lift.

4️⃣ Shoulder Placement: Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging to keep your traps relaxed and focus the tension on your delts.

Master these cues, and your dumbbell shoulder press will be safer and more effective! 💪

📌 Shoulder Press Mistake I Fix Your Form
candidates.description:
If you’re shrugging your shoulders up while pressing, you’re actually hitting your traps more than your delts. That’s not what we want. Keep your shoulders down and relaxed. Stay tall, keep your neck long, and don’t let your ears and shoulders become friends. This way you’re actually targeting your shoulders the right way. 💪
